mapper.select: SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ null outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ deal.BOOKSET_ID prodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME prodName,/**金融产品名称**/ fpt.TYPE_6 contractType, /**合约类型**/ ftr.finprod_id targetId, /**合约标的**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ ftr.TERM term,/**期限**/ t.VDATE vdate,/**起息日**/ t.MDATE mdate,/**到期日**/ t.COUNTER_ID counterId,/**交易对手**/ ftr.PRIN nomCapi,/**名义本金**/ null exerciseDate,/**行权日基准日**/ null exePrice,/**执行价格**/ null knockPrice,/**敲出价格**/ null lowHindPrice,/**低障碍价**/ null lowExercPrice,/**低行权价**/ null highHindPrice,/**高障碍价**/ null highExercPrice,/**高行权价**/ null exerciseType,/**行权方式**/ null optFeePayType,/**期权费类型**/ null optFee,/**期权费**/ null optFeeRate,/**期权费率**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ null otherAmt,/**其他应付费用**/ stl.SETTLE_AMT settleAmt,/**结算金额**/ stl.MY_ACCT_NO acctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftr on ftr.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID = ftr.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE ='38' AND stl.ORDER_TYPE in('2749','2748') where t.BUSI_TYPE ='38' and t.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} order by t.TRADE_ID desc

SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ deal.BOOKSET_ID prodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME prodName,/**金融产品名称**/ fpt.TYPE_6 contractType, /**合约类型**/ ftr.finprod_id targetId, /**合约标的**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ t.VDATE payDate,/**起息日**/ null payment, t.COUNTER_ID counterId,/**交易对手**/ ftr.PRIN nomCapi,/**名义本金**/ null exerciseType,/**行权方式**/ null optFee,/**期权费**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ stl.SETTLE_AMT settleAmt,/**结算金额**/ stl.MY_ACCT_NO acctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftr on ftr.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON fpt.FINPROD_ID = ftr.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE ='38' AND stl.ORDER_TYPE in('2749','2748') where t.BUSI_TYPE ='38' and t.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} order by t.TRADE_ID desc

SELECT ftp.FINPROD_ID id, ftp.FINPROD_ID text FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp WHERE ftp.FINPROD_TYPE =#{FINPROD_TYPE_F35}
and ftp.FINPROD_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%'))

SELECT T4.COUNTER_ID id, T4.COUNTER_NAME text FROM ( SELECT T1.COUNTER_ID, T1.COUNTER_TYPE, T1.COUNTER_NAME, T1.LINK_ID, CASE T1.COUNTER_TYPE WHEN '03' THEN T2.ISSUER WHEN '02' THEN T1.MANAGER_ID ELSE '' END AS MANA, T2.TRUSTEE_ID, T3.TYPE_6, T3.TYPE_7 FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T2 ON T1.LINK_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T3 ON T1.LINK_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID
T1.COUNTER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) or T1.COUNTER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%'))
ORDER BY T1.COUNTER_TYPE DESC ) T4 LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T5 ON T5.CUSTOMER_ID = T4.MANA AND T5.IS_ASSTE_MANAGER = 'Y' LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T6 ON T6.CUSTOMER_ID = T4.TRUSTEE_ID AND T6.IS_TRUSTER = 'Y'
